post_ship_review.fix: 14 findings adjudicated: 12 CONFIRMED + 2 NEEDS_NUANCE, all applied. Key fixes — (1) §1.1 scaling-law description rewritten from single log-product to Kaplan's 3 independent power laws + Chinchilla optimal N:D ratio; (2) §3.1 ORM/PRM table 'training objective' row corrected from downstream RL policy objective (max E[r]) to the reward model's actual supervised loss (BCE / per-step classification), with a footnote distinguishing the two; (3) Lightman 2023 numbers corrected best-of-1024/78%/72%/70% → N=1860 re-ranking/78.2%/72.4%/69.6% (2 spots); (4) residual 'MCTS-label' terminology (Math-Shepherd is plain MC completion rollout, not MCTS tree search) fixed at 3 remaining spots + 1 timeline-table row; (5) GRPO loss code changed from a global (loss*mask).sum()/mask.sum() reduction (length-biased, the DAPO/Dr.GRPO-flagged bug) to per-completion length normalization + equal-weight mean across G, matching DeepSeekMath's (1/G)Σ_i(1/|o_i|)Σ_t[...] form; KL-magnitude wording in Q20 nuanced (per-token noise accumulates, not 'total mechanically scales'); (6) G=16 / β=0.001 R1 hyperparameters annotated as community reproduction/estimate, not officially published (3 spots, NEEDS_NUANCE); (7) '~147K H800-hours / two orders of magnitude smaller than GPT-4' claim removed as unverifiable, replaced with the actually-disclosed DeepSeek-V3 pretraining cost (~2.788M H800-hours) and an explicit non-disclosure note (2 spots); (8) R1 Stage-3 filtering corrected from 'PRM/rules' to rule/answer verification + DeepSeek-V3 generative judging (no PRM); (9) R1-Distill SFT data corrected from '60万 reasoning' to the full ~80万 (60万 reasoning + 20万 general) (2 spots); (10) 'PaLM-2 14× larger model' claims annotated as FLOPs-matched accounting since PaLM-2's parameter counts were never officially disclosed (5 spots, NEEDS_NUANCE); (11) Snell 2024 simple/hard-problem strategy swapped back (easy→sequential revision, hard→parallel sampling+verifier, not the reverse) (2 spots); (12) 'Snell 2024 recommends MCTS for very-hard problems' corrected — Snell 2024 only evaluated up to PRM beam search, MCTS attribution moved to rStar/rStar-Math; (13) s1-32B training epochs corrected 1→5; (14) Q24 BoN/ToT/MCTS no-longer lumped together under 'no information exchange between traces' — split into per-method behavior (BoN independent, ToT shares tree prefix, MCTS shares via visit-count backup).
